name: Epic Ambient AI Integrations
description: Epic Systems offers ambient AI documentation through two paths: 1) Epic AI Charting—Epic's own ambient AI rolled out February 2026, pricing not publicly disclosed but may be included with standard licensing; 2) Integrated third-party partners including Nuance DAX Copilot (Dragon Copilot) and Abridge. Epic holds 42% of the acute care EHR market. Nuance DAX is deeply embedded in Epic Hyperspace via Microsoft Pal partnership with native SmartText field population—pricing runs $369-830/provider/month with multi-year contracts required. Abridge holds #1 Best in KLAS for Ambient AI 2025-2026 and is Epic's first official 'Pal.' The depth of Epic integration (auto-populating discrete-data fields rather than free-text dumps) took years to build and competitors are still catching up.
short_description: Epic ambient AI: Native AI Charting + Nuance DAX ($369-830/mo) + Abridge integrations. Deep EHR integration via Microsoft Pal.

faqs.q: How much does Epic ambient AI cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Epic AI Charting (native) pricing is not publicly disclosed—may be included with licensing. Nuance DAX Copilot runs $369-830/provider/month depending on contract. Abridge requires custom enterprise pricing. All require multi-year contracts for health systems.

faqs.q: What makes Epic ambient AI integration different?
faqs.a: Epic's integration depth is unmatched—Nuance DAX auto-populates SmartText discrete-data fields rather than free-text dumps. This native workflow (via Microsoft Pal partnership) took years to build. Competitors are still catching up.

faqs.q: What is Abridge and why is it Epic's 'Pal'?
faqs.a: Abridge holds #1 Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026. It's Epic's first official 'Pal'—a designation for deep integration partners. Abridge offers enterprise contracts for health systems using Epic.

faqs.q: Is Epic ambient AI good for small practices?
faqs.a: No. Epic ambient AI is enterprise-focused with $369-830/mo pricing and multi-year contracts. Small practices should consider Freed ($39-119/mo), Commure ($59-89/mo), or PatientNotes ($50/mo) instead.

faqs.q: Epic ambient AI vs Freed vs Commure: which is better?
faqs.a: Epic ambient AI ($369-830/mo) offers deepest EHR integration for health systems. Freed ($39-119/mo) works via browser extension—cheaper but less integrated. Commure ($59-89/mo) offers good integration at mid-tier pricing. For enterprise Epic users, go native. For everyone else, consider alternatives.
